        venue: "arXiv 2503.05703"
        arxiv_id: "2503.05703"
        role: method-component

        metrics:
          cruxeval_accuracy: "~80%"
          mbpp_accuracy: "~80%"

      - title: "Demystifying Errors in LLM Reasoning Traces: An Empirical Study of Code Execution Simulation"
        authors: "Mohammad Abdollahi, Khandaker Rifah Tasnia, Soumit Kanti Saha, Jinqiu Yang, Song Wang, Hadi Hemmati"
        year: 2025
        venue: "arXiv"
        arxiv_id: "2512.00215"
        role: evaluation
        key_finding: "LLM 在循环中频繁遗漏/多算变量修改，函数返回值预测不准。说明 LLM 对具体值追踪能力弱于结构理解，为 plan_001 发现（值冗余）提供机制解释。"
        metrics: {}

        authors: "Junkai Chen et al."
        year: 2024
        venue: "arXiv 2403.16437"
        role: evaluation
        key_finding: "REval 框架评估 LLM 在 4 种 runtime behavior 预测任务上的表现：coverage prediction、program state prediction、execution path prediction、output prediction。平均 accuracy 仅 44.4%，IC score 10.3。揭示 LLM runtime reasoning 能力有限，支持 VOTA 的发现——需要抽象而非让 LLM 直接消化全量 trace。"
        metrics:
          avg_accuracy: "44.4%"
          avg_ic_score: "10.3"

        authors: "Changshu Liu et al. (UIUC)"
        year: 2024
        venue: "arXiv 2402.09664"
        role: evaluation
        key_finding: "评估 LLM 在 IER（执行推理）、SR（规格推理）、DSR（动态语义推理）三个维度的代码推理能力。性能随代码复杂度（控制流、非原始类型、API 调用）显著下降。支持 VOTA 的 trace abstraction 动机——复杂 trace 超出 LLM 推理能力。"
        metrics: {}

        authors: "Ruiyang Xu et al. (HKUST)"
        year: 2025
        venue: "ACL 2025"
        arxiv_id: "2408.13001"
        role: evaluation
        key_finding: "将 CRUXEval 扩展到 19 种编程语言，19K 测试。仅在 Python 训练的模型在其他语言最高 34.4% Pass@1，揭示 cross-language generalization 的局限。对 VOTA 的 cross-model generalization 实验提供方法论参考。"
        metrics:
          languages: 19
          cross_lang_max_pass1: "34.4%"

      - title: "Chain of Execution Supervision Promotes General Reasoning in Large Language Models"
        authors: "Nuo Chen, Zehua Li, Keqin Bao, Junyang Lin, Dayiheng Liu (Qwen/Alibaba, HKUST-GZ, USTC)"
        year: 2025
        venue: "NeurIPS 2025"
        arxiv_id: "2510.23629"
        verified: true
        role: direct-competitor
        key_finding: "提出 TracePile——2.6M Chain-of-Execution trace 样本（~19B tokens），涵盖数学/算法/竞赛代码。在 4 个 base model、20 个 benchmark 上验证 trace 监督提升推理能力，但仅评估生成任务，未涉及 verdict classification。"
        metrics:
          dataset_size: "2.6M samples"
          dataset_tokens: "~19B"
          benchmarks_evaluated: 20

      - title: "TRACED: Execution-aware Pre-training for Source Code"
        authors: "Yangruibo Ding, Ben Steenhoek, Kexin Pei, Gail Kaiser, Wei Le, Baishakhi Ray"
        year: 2024
        venue: "ICSE 2024"
        arxiv_id: "2306.07487"
        verified: true

        key_finding: "用源码+可执行输入+execution trace 做 execution-aware 预训练（encoder-based），在执行路径预测提升 12.4%、运行时变量值预测提升 25.2%。证明 trace 有助于 encoder-based 分类任务，但仅用于预训练而非直接做 verdict classification。"
        metrics:
          execution_path_prediction_improvement: "+12.4%"
          runtime_value_prediction_improvement: "+25.2%"

        venue: "ICSE 2026"

          pass_at_1_improvement: "+34.43%"

        role: background

        metrics:
          repair_accuracy_improvement: "+5.10-60.37%"

          cruxeval_accuracy: "~80%"
          mbpp_accuracy: "~80%"

      - title: "Demystifying Errors in LLM Reasoning Traces: An Empirical Study of Code Execution Simulation"
        authors: "Mohammad Abdollahi, Khandaker Rifah Tasnia, Soumit Kanti Saha, Jinqiu Yang, Song Wang, Hadi Hemmati"
        year: 2025
        venue: "arXiv"
        arxiv_id: "2512.00215"
        role: evaluation
        key_finding: "LLM 在循环中频繁遗漏/多算变量修改，函数返回值预测不准。说明 LLM 对具体值追踪能力弱于结构理解，为 plan_001 发现（值冗余）提供机制解释。"
        metrics: {}

      - title: "Reasoning Runtime Behavior of a Program with LLM: How Far Are We? (REval)"
        authors: "Junkai Chen et al."
        year: 2024
        venue: "arXiv 2403.16437"
        role: evaluation
        key_finding: "REval 框架评估 LLM 在 4 种 runtime behavior 预测任务上的表现：coverage prediction、program state prediction、execution path prediction、output prediction。平均 accuracy 仅 44.4%，IC score 10.3。揭示 LLM runtime reasoning 能力有限，支持 VOTA 的发现——需要抽象而非让 LLM 直接消化全量 trace。"
        metrics:
          avg_accuracy: "44.4%"
          avg_ic_score: "10.3"

      - title: "CodeMind: Evaluating Large Language Models for Code Reasoning"
        authors: "Changshu Liu et al. (UIUC)"
        year: 2024
        venue: "arXiv 2402.09664"
        role: evaluation
        key_finding: "评估 LLM 在 IER（执行推理）、SR（规格推理）、DSR（动态语义推理）三个维度的代码推理能力。性能随代码复杂度（控制流、非原始类型、API 调用）显著下降。支持 VOTA 的 trace abstraction 动机——复杂 trace 超出 LLM 推理能力。"
        metrics: {}

      - title: "CRUXEval-X: A Benchmark for Multilingual Code Reasoning, Understanding and Execution"
        authors: "Ruiyang Xu et al. (HKUST)"
        year: 2025
        venue: "ACL 2025"
        arxiv_id: "2408.13001"
        role: evaluation
        key_finding: "将 CRUXEval 扩展到 19 种编程语言，19K 测试。仅在 Python 训练的模型在其他语言最高 34.4% Pass@1，揭示 cross-language generalization 的局限。对 VOTA 的 cross-model generalization 实验提供方法论参考。"
        metrics:
          languages: 19
          cross_lang_max_pass1: "34.4%"

      - title: "Chain of Execution Supervision Promotes General Reasoning in Large Language Models"
        authors: "Nuo Chen, Zehua Li, Keqin Bao, Junyang Lin, Dayiheng Liu (Qwen/Alibaba, HKUST-GZ, USTC)"
        year: 2025
        venue: "NeurIPS 2025"
        arxiv_id: "2510.23629"
        verified: true
        role: direct-competitor
        key_finding: "提出 TracePile——2.6M Chain-of-Execution trace 样本（~19B tokens），涵盖数学/算法/竞赛代码。在 4 个 base model、20 个 benchmark 上验证 trace 监督提升推理能力，但仅评估生成任务，未涉及 verdict classification。"
        metrics:
          dataset_size: "2.6M samples"
          dataset_tokens: "~19B"
          benchmarks_evaluated: 20

      - title: "TRACED: Execution-aware Pre-training for Source Code"
        authors: "Yangruibo Ding, Ben Steenhoek, Kexin Pei, Gail Kaiser, Wei Le, Baishakhi Ray"
        year: 2024
        venue: "ICSE 2024"
        arxiv_id: "2306.07487"
        verified: true
        role: direct-competitor
        key_finding: "用源码+可执行输入+execution trace 做 execution-aware 预训练（encoder-based），在执行路径预测提升 12.4%、运行时变量值预测提升 25.2%。证明 trace 有助于 encoder-based 分类任务，但仅用于预训练而非直接做 verdict classification。"
        metrics:
          execution_path_prediction_improvement: "+12.4%"
          runtime_value_prediction_improvement: "+25.2%"

  code-verdict:
    description: "LLM 判断代码 pass/fail、正确性分类、mutation testing"
    papers:
      - title: "APPT: Boosting Automated Patch Correctness Prediction via Fine-tuning Pre-trained Models"
        authors: "iSEngLab (Nanjing University)"
        year: 2024
        venue: "IEEE TSE 2024"
        role: direct-competitor
        key_finding: "BERT + LSTM + classifier 微调做 patch 正确性二分类。在 1183 个 Defects4J patches 上 accuracy 79.7%、recall 83.2%，优于 CACHE。与 VOTA 的 verdict 分类目标最接近。"
        metrics:
          accuracy: "79.7%"
          recall: "83.2%"
          f1_improvement_from_finetuning: "+10.22%"

      - title: "LLM4PatchCorrect: Leveraging Large Language Model for Automatic Patch Correctness Assessment"
        authors: "Xin Zhou et al. (SMU)"
        year: 2024
        venue: "IEEE TSE 2024"
        role: direct-competitor
        key_finding: "用 Starcoder-7B 零样本评估 patch 正确性，输入包含 bug description、execution traces、failing test cases、test coverage。无需微调即达 84.4% accuracy。使用了 execution trace 作为输入信号，与 VOTA 输入空间有重叠，但方法（zero-shot prompting vs SFT）和任务（patch correctness vs test verdict）不同。"
        metrics:
          accuracy: "84.4%"
          f1: "86.5%"
        novelty_threat: medium

      - title: "Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning with Attributed Patch Semantic Graph for Automated Patch Correctness Assessment"
        authors: "Zhenyu Yang, Jingwen Wu, Zhen Yang, Zhongxing Yu"
        year: 2025
        venue: "arXiv 2505.02629"
        arxiv_id: "2505.02629"
        role: direct-competitor
        key_finding: "提出 APSG（Attributed Patch Semantic Graph）+ Graph-LoRA，用图结构捕获 patch 语义的 data/control flow。在 patch correctness 上比 SOTA 提升 accuracy 3.1-7.5%、F1 3.0-7.1%。方法论（PEFT + 结构化代码表示做分类）与 VOTA 有相似之处，但 VOTA 用 trace signal 而非 graph。"
        metrics:
          accuracy_improvement: "+3.1-7.5%"
          f1_improvement: "+3.0-7.1%"
        novelty_threat: medium

      - title: "Calibration and Correctness of Language Models for Code"
        authors: "Claudio Spiess, David Gros, et al."
        year: 2025
        venue: "ICSE 2025"
        arxiv_id: "2402.02047"
        role: evaluation
        key_finding: "代码生成模型的置信度校准普遍较差。Platt scaling 可改善但需要先验正确性数据。对 VOTA 的启示：verdict 分类需关注校准，不只是准确率。"
        metrics: {}

      - title: "Mutation-Guided LLM-based Test Generation at Meta"
        authors: "Christopher Foster et al. (Meta)"
        year: 2025
        venue: "FSE 2025 (Industry)"
        arxiv_id: "2501.12862"
        role: evaluation
        key_finding: "LLM equivalence detector 判断 mutant 是否等价，加简单预处理后 precision 0.95、recall 0.96。大规模部署到 10K+ 类，工程师接受率 73%。展示了 LLM 做代码正确性判断的工业可行性。"
        metrics:
          precision: "0.95"
          recall: "0.96"
          classes_evaluated: "10795"
          test_acceptance_rate: "73%"

      - title: "FuseFL: Demystifying Faulty Code with LLM via Step-by-Step Reasoning"
        authors: "Ratnadira Widyasari et al. (SMU)"
        year: 2024
        venue: "SANER 2024"
        role: background
        key_finding: "融合 SBFL 排名 + test execution outcomes（input、expected/actual output、errors）+ code description 做 fault localization。Top-1 localization 比 baseline 提升 32.3%，比 SBFL 提升 68.4%。test execution outcomes 作为输入信号与 VOTA 的 fault indicator signals 理念相关。"
        metrics:
          top1_improvement_over_baseline: "+32.3%"
          top1_improvement_over_sbfl: "+68.4%"

      - title: "CRUXEval: A Benchmark for Code Reasoning, Understanding and Execution"
        authors: "Alex Gu, Baptiste Rozière, Hugh James Leather, Armando Solar-Lezama, Gabriel Synnaeve, Sida Wang"
        year: 2024
        venue: "ICML 2024"
        arxiv_id: "2401.03065"
        verified: true
        role: evaluation
        key_finding: "800 个 Python 函数的代码推理 benchmark，包含 input prediction 和 output prediction 两个任务。GPT-4+CoT 达 75%/81% pass@1。作为 VOTA 实验的数据集来源。"
        metrics:
          benchmark_size: 800
          gpt4_cot_input_pass1: "75%"
          gpt4_cot_output_pass1: "81%"

  trace-compression:
    description: "Execution trace 的压缩、摘要、抽象方法"
    papers:
      - title: "Predictive Program Slicing via Execution Knowledge-Guided Dynamic Dependence Learning"
        authors: "Aashish Yadavally, Yi Li, Tien Nguyen"
        year: 2024
        venue: "FSE 2024"
        role: method-component
        key_finding: "ND-Slicer 用 execution-aware 预训练学习动态依赖，无需实际执行即可预测特定输入的程序切片。Python 上 exact-match 81.31%、ROUGE-LCS 0.954。与 VOTA 的 assertion-point snapshots 思路类似——都是从完整 trace 中提取关键信息。"
        metrics:
          exact_match: "81.31%"
          rouge_lcs: "0.954"
          fault_localization_accuracy: "63.88%"

      - title: "Towards Effectively Leveraging Execution Traces for Program Repair with Code LLMs"
        authors: "Mirazul Haque, Petr Babkin, et al. (J.P. Morgan AI Research)"
        year: 2025
        venue: "KnowledgeNLP Workshop @ ACL 2025"
        arxiv_id: "2505.04441"
        role: background
        key_finding: "直接将 execution trace 加入 prompt 帮助有限，且随 trace 复杂度增加效果递减。LLM 优化的 prompt 格式比原始 trace 更一致地优于无 trace baseline。直接支持 VOTA 的核心假设：原始 trace 太冗长，需要专门的压缩/抽象。"
        metrics: {}

      - title: "Making LLMs Program Interpreters via Execution Trace Chain of Thought (ET-CoT)"
        authors: "Koshi Eguchi, Takuya Akiba"
        year: 2025
        venue: "ICML 2025 Workshop PRAL"
        openreview_id: "pFyBdPyOCQ"
        role: method-component
        key_finding: "开发 PyTracify 工具生成 sub-line 粒度的结构化 execution trace，SFT 后 Qwen2.5-7B 在 CRUXEval-O 达 70.0%、LiveCodeBench 达 88.3%，超过同规模 code-oriented 模型。其 trace 格式本身是一种 trace abstraction。"
        metrics:
          cruxeval_o: "70.0%"
          livecodebench_execution: "88.3%"

      - title: "TraceCoder: A Trace-Driven Multi-Agent Framework for Automated Debugging of LLM-Generated Code"
        authors: "Jiangping Huang, Wenguang Ye, Weisong Sun, Jian Zhang, Mingyue Zhang, Yang Liu"
        year: 2026
        venue: "ICSE 2026"
        arxiv_id: "2602.06875"
        verified: true
        role: background
        key_finding: "在特定位置插入 diagnostic probes 而非全量 trace 记录，Pass@1 提升 34.43%。选择性 trace 采集优于全量，支持 VOTA 的行为模式抽象思路。"
        metrics:
          pass_at_1_improvement: "+34.43%"

      - title: "Runtime Execution Traces Guided Automated Program Repair with Multi-Agent Debate"
        authors: "Jiaqing Wu, Tong Wu, Manqing Zhang, Yunwei Dong, Bo Shen"
        year: 2026
        venue: "arXiv 2604.02647"
        arxiv_id: "2604.02647"
        verified: true
        role: background
        key_finding: "Probe agent 选择性捕获 critical variables 的 execution snapshots 用于 multi-agent repair debate，修复 392 个缺陷。验证了选择性 trace 信息优于全量记录。"
        metrics:
          defects_fixed: "392"

      - title: "InspectCoder: Dynamic Analysis-Enabled Self Repair through Interactive LLM-Debugger Collaboration"
        authors: "Yunkun Wang, Yue Zhang, Guochang Li, Chen Zhi, Binhua Li, Fei Huang, Yongbin Li, Shuiguang Deng"
        year: 2025
        venue: "arXiv 2510.18327"
        arxiv_id: "2510.18327"
        role: background
        key_finding: "首个让 LLM 主动控制 debugger 做动态分析的 agentic repair 系统。Program Inspector 做策略性 breakpoint 放置和 runtime state 检查，Patch Coder 合成修复。比最强 baseline 提升 5.10-60.37%。选择性 runtime 检查理念与 VOTA 的 fault indicator signal 提取一致。"
        metrics:
          repair_accuracy_improvement: "+5.10-60.37%"

      - title: "MGDebugger: From Code to Correctness via Hierarchical Debugging"
        authors: "Yuling Shi et al."
        year: 2024
        venue: "arXiv 2410.01215"
        role: background
        key_finding: "层次化分解代码为子函数树，LLM 模拟执行追踪关键变量状态，bottom-up 定位修复。HumanEval accuracy 75.6%→94.5%。其 LLM-simulated executor 追踪变量状态的方式是一种隐式 trace abstraction。"
        metrics:
          humaneval_accuracy: "94.5%"
          humaneval_fix_accuracy: "97.6%"

  debugging-agents:
    description: "LLM 多智能体调试框架"
    papers:
      - title: "UniDebugger: Hierarchical Multi-Agent Framework for Unified Software Debugging"
        authors: "Cheryl Lee, Chunqiu Steven Xia, et al. (Lingming Zhang group)"
        year: 2025
        venue: "EMNLP 2025"
        arxiv_id: "2404.17153"
        role: background
        key_finding: "三层认知架构模拟开发者调试过程，L1→L2→L3 逐层升级。在 Defects4J 上修复 1.25-2.56x bugs。不使用 execution trace 作为输入（纯静态分析），与 VOTA 方法正交。"
        metrics:
          defects4j_improvement: "1.25-2.56x"

      - title: "Seeker: Enhancing Exception Handling in Code with LLM-based Multi-Agent Approach"
        authors: "Xuanming Zhang, Yuxuan Chen, Yuan Yuan, Minlie Huang"
        year: 2025
        venue: "ICLR 2025"
        arxiv_id: "2410.06949"
        role: background
        key_finding: "5-agent 框架做 exception handling 生成，构建 Common Exception Enumeration (CEE) 知识库。Exception handling precision 提升 37%。从 exception taxonomy 角度提供背景——exception 类型和处理策略的系统化，与 VOTA 的 exception event 信号提取视角互补。"
        metrics:
          exception_handling_precision_improvement: "+37%"

  sft-classification:
    description: "用 SFT 做分类任务的方法论和 findings"
    papers:
      - title: "Fine-Tuning Causal LLMs for Text Classification: Embedding-Based vs. Instruction-Based Approaches"
        authors: "Amirhossein Yousefiramandi, Ciaran Cooney"
        year: 2025
        venue: "arXiv 2512.12677"
        arxiv_id: "2512.12677"
        role: method-component
        key_finding: "对比 embedding-based（加分类头）vs instruction-based（prompt->response）两种 SFT 分类方式。Embedding-based + QLoRA 在 F1 上与 instruction-tuned 持平，但可训练参数少得多。对 VOTA 的 verdict 分类有直接参考价值——选哪种 SFT 格式。"
        metrics: {}

      - title: "FisherSFT: Data-Efficient Supervised Fine-Tuning of Language Models Using Information Gain"
        authors: "Rohan Deb, Kiran Koshy Thekumparampil, Kousha Kalantari, Gaurush Hiranandani, Shoham Sabach, Branislav Kveton"
        year: 2025
        venue: "ICML 2025"
        arxiv_id: "2505.14826"
        role: background
        key_finding: "用 Fisher 信息矩阵选择信息量最大的训练样本子集，通过 last-layer 线性化高效近似。在固定数据预算下提升 SFT 效果。对 VOTA 的数据选择策略有参考价值。"
        metrics: {}

      - title: "Fine-Tuned 'Small' LLMs (Still) Significantly Outperform Zero-Shot Generative AI Models in Text Classification"
        authors: "Martin Juan Jose Bucher, Marco Martini"
        year: 2024
        venue: "arXiv 2406.08660"
        role: background
        key_finding: "跨多种分类任务（情感、立场、情绪等），fine-tuned 小模型全面优于 GPT-4/Claude 的 zero-shot。验证了 VOTA 用 SFT 做 verdict 分类的基本假设——fine-tuning 在分类上优于 prompting。"
        metrics: {}

  cross-model-generalization:
    description: "跨模型 SFT 泛化：不同 base model 上 SFT 效果的迁移与差异"
    papers:
      - title: "Unveiling the Generalization Power of Fine-Tuned Large Language Models"
        authors: "Haoran Yang, Yumeng Zhang, Jiaqi Xu, Hongyuan Lu, Pheng Ann Heng, Wai Lam"
        year: 2024
        venue: "NAACL 2024"
        arxiv_id: "2403.09162"
        role: method-component
        key_finding: "SFT 后分类任务跨域正迁移，生成任务跨域负迁移。对 VOTA 的跨模型实验设计有直接参考——verdict 分类属于分类任务，预期正迁移。"
        metrics: {}

      - title: "How Abilities in Large Language Models are Affected by Supervised Fine-tuning Data Composition"
        authors: "Guanting Dong, Hongyi Yuan, Keming Lu, et al."
        year: 2024
        venue: "ACL 2024"
        arxiv_id: "2310.05492"
        role: method-component
        key_finding: "更大/更强 base model 在相同 SFT 数据量下性能更优。DeepSeek-Coder-6.7B 预训练 2T tokens，Qwen 5.5T，比例 2.75x。对 VOTA 跨模型对比（DeepSeek vs Qwen）提供预训练数据量的基准参考。"
        metrics:
          deepseek_coder_pretrain_tokens: "2T"
          qwen_pretrain_tokens: "5.5T"

      - title: "Analyzing the Effects of Supervised Fine-Tuning on Model Knowledge from Token and Parameter Levels"
        authors: "Junjie Ye, Yuming Yang, Yang Nan, Shuo Li, Qi Zhang, Tao Gui, Xuanjing Huang, Peng Wang, Zhongchao Shi, Jianping Fan"
        year: 2025
        venue: "EMNLP 2025"
        arxiv_id: "2509.16596"
        role: background
        key_finding: "SFT 中 90% 参数更新不贡献知识增强；知识掌握水平不同的训练数据导致 >12% 性能波动。对 VOTA 的数据质量控制有参考意义。"
        metrics:
          non_contributing_param_ratio: "90%"
          performance_variation_from_data_quality: ">12%"

      - title: "From Code to Prediction: Fine-Tuning LLMs for Neural Network Performance Classification in NNGPT"
        authors: "Mahmoud Hanouneh, Radu Timofte, Dmitry Ignatov"
        year: 2025
        venue: "arXiv 2605.03686"
        arxiv_id: "2605.03686"
        role: background
        key_finding: "DeepSeek-Coder-7B-Instruct LoRA 微调做代码分类 80% accuracy。验证 DeepSeek-Coder 系列在代码分类 SFT 上的可行性。"
        metrics:
          code_classification_accuracy: "80%"

      - title: "Qwen2.5-Coder Technical Report"
        authors: "Binyuan Hui, Jian Yang, et al. (Qwen Team)"
        year: 2024
        venue: "arXiv 2409.12186"
        arxiv_id: "2409.12186"
        role: background
        key_finding: "Qwen2.5-Coder 5.5T tokens 预训练，HumanEval 92.7%。作为 VOTA 跨模型实验的 base model 之一，提供预训练规模和代码能力基准。"
        metrics:
          pretrain_tokens: "5.5T"
          humaneval_pass1: "92.7%"
